Orbitra Inference Platform - Overview. Orbitra Inference Platform serves large language models and vision models behind an OpenAI-compatible API. It runs on-premises, in a private cloud or as a managed service.

Orbitra Inference Platform - Performance and scaling. The platform autoscales model replicas on request queue depth and supports batching. Typical latency targets are under 300 milliseconds to first token for 8B parameter models.
Orbitra Inference Platform - Security. Deployments can run fully inside a customer network with no data leaving the environment. Supports single sign-on, role-based access control and audit logging.
Orbitra Vector DB - Overview. Orbitra Vector DB stores embeddings for retrieval augmented generation and semantic search. It combines vector similarity with keyword (BM25) search in one hybrid query.

Orbitra Vector DB - Access control. Metadata filters such as territory, document owner and classification are applied inside the similarity search, so users only retrieve documents they are allowed to see.
Orbitra Vector DB - Freshness. Incremental upserts keep the index current; catalogue or document changes are searchable within about one minute.
Orbitra Guard - Overview. Orbitra Guard adds input, output and retrieval guardrails to generative AI applications.
Orbitra Guard - Privacy. Detects and redacts personal data such as emails, phone numbers and names before text is sent to a model, and restores it for authorised users.
Orbitra Guard - Prompt injection. Scans retrieved documents and user input for prompt injection patterns and quarantines suspicious content. Every decision is written to an audit log.
Orbitra Edge Appliance - Overview. Orbitra Edge Appliance is a ruggedised GPU server for computer vision and language inference at factories, plants and remote sites.
Orbitra Edge Appliance - Environment. Rated for 0 to 50 degrees Celsius and dust-protected enclosures. Runs disconnected and syncs models when connectivity returns.
Orbitra Edge Appliance - Latency. Vision models typically run under 30 milliseconds per frame on the appliance.
Orbitra Document AI - Overview. Orbitra Document AI extracts fields and tables from scanned forms, invoices, bills of lading and claim forms.
Orbitra Document AI - Accuracy. Field-level extraction accuracy is typically above 95 percent on printed forms; handwritten annotations are supported in preview with lower accuracy.

Competitive brief: Kordon Cloud, Brightlake AI and Pyxel Compute - Kordon Cloud. Kordon Cloud is a hosted-only offering. Position Orbitra on private deployment, data residency and predictable pricing.

Competitive brief: Kordon Cloud, Brightlake AI and Pyxel Compute - Brightlake AI. Brightlake AI offers a strong hosted API but limited regional hosting. Position Orbitra on data residency and audit trails.
Competitive brief: Kordon Cloud, Brightlake AI and Pyxel Compute - Pyxel Compute. Pyxel Compute competes on GPU price. Position Orbitra on total cost including software, guardrails and support.

Pricing and discount policy - Discount authority. Account executives may approve discounts up to 10 percent. Discounts from 10 to 20 percent need sales manager approval. Anything above 20 percent goes to the deal desk.
